0.4.0.description:
Test build of the shuffled castle. Expect some bugs, and please open an [issue](https://github.com/Arcadia64/sotn-recomp-archipelago/issues) if you find one.

- New options to shuffle the castle, ported from Sestren's SOTN Shuffler: `shuffle_rooms` lays out each area's rooms differently, `shuffle_area_connections` changes which areas lead to which. Both are off by default. The logic, the pause map and the Map window follow the new layout.
- `map_area_colors`: with a shuffled castle, the pause map shows each area in its own colour
- With a shuffled castle, the Castle map from the Librarian shows the whole castle
- `starting_area`: sotn.io's fixes for Royal Chapel and Castle Keep starts

**Downloads**
- [sotn-archipelago-mod.zip](https://github.com/Arcadia64/sotn-recomp-archipelago/releases/download/0.4.0/sotn-archipelago-mod.zip): goes in recomp's `/mods/` folder
- [sotn_recomp.apworld](https://github.com/Arcadia64/sotn-recomp-archipelago/releases/download/0.4.0/sotn_recomp.apworld)
- [Symphony-of-the-Night-Recomp.yaml](https://github.com/Arcadia64/sotn-recomp-archipelago/releases/download/0.4.0/Symphony-of-the-Night-Recomp.yaml): default options

**Setup**: 
- See the [README](https://github.com/Arcadia64/sotn-recomp-archipelago#setup).
